name: FAQ, big question mark
description: A dark band with a giant tilted question mark in the background and bold, oversized questions that open one at a time.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: What first-timers want to know before they chalk up at our climbing centre in Sheffield.

itemFields.name: answer
itemFields.label: Answer
itemFields.default: Forty free spaces behind the building, and bike racks by the door.

default.question: Never climbed before?
default.answer: Good. Book a 90-minute taster for £22 and an instructor will have you up a wall, and safely down again, within the first ten minutes.

default.question: Scared of heights?
default.answer: Most of us are. Start in the bouldering room, where the walls stop at 4.5 metres and the floor is one very large mattress.

default.question: What do I wear?
default.answer: Anything you can stretch in. Climbing shoes and chalk are included on your first visit, and shoe hire is £4 after that.

default.question: Can I come alone?
default.answer: Yes. Bouldering needs no partner, and at the Tuesday social we pair you with someone at your level.

default.question: How old is old enough?
default.answer: Five for kids' club and 14 to climb without an adult. There is no upper limit: our oldest member is 78.

default.question: Do I have to join?
default.answer: No. Day entry is £13. Monthly membership is £49 and pays for itself in four visits.
